chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-'Abbas, from 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn Muskan, who raised it to Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever sleeps before performing the 'atamah prayer and does not awaken until half the night has passed, then let him make up his prayer and seek Allah’s forgiveness.

key_terms.الْعَتَمَةَ: the night prayer, referring here to the 'Isha prayer
key_terms.صَلَاتَهُ: his prayer, the obligatory salat that was missed
key_terms.فَلْيَقْضِ: let him make up, meaning to perform the missed prayer as qada'
key_terms.نِصْفُ اللَّيْلِ: the midpoint of the night, a key legal time boundary
key_terms.وَلْيَسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ: and let him seek Allah’s forgiveness, indicating repentance and asking pardon

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they sleep before praying al-'atamah and wake up after half the night has passed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling about one who misses the night prayer due to sleep until after the midpoint of the night. It instructs such a person to perform the missed prayer as qada' and to seek forgiveness from Allah.
